rows.label: tlk43600143_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Ever hear of Charcoal-Grilled Tekka
Bird?

rows.label: tlk43600143_04_msg0002
rows.name:
It's probably the tastiest thing
I've ever eaten in my life, and
that's no exaggeration!

rows.label: tlk43600143_04_msg0003
rows.name:
The first time I ate it, I was moved
by how good it was.

rows.label: tlk43600143_04_msg0004
rows.name:
Who'd have thought collaborating with
Superbia would create food this good?
It goes great with drinks too.

rows.label: tlk43600143_04_msg0005
rows.name:
Alst may be headed for ruin, but I'm
dipping into my savings to eat
Charcoal-Grilled Tekka Bird every day.

rows.label: tlk43600143_04_msg0006
rows.name:
After living this long and
tasting food like that, I can
die satisfied now.
